assessment: This is a useful study exploring multi-modality brain age (structural plus resting state MRI) in people in the early stages or at risk of Alzheimer's disease. They found solid evidence that people with cognitive impairment had older-appearing brains and that older-appearing brains were related to Alzheimer's risk factors such as amyloid and tau deposition. Their data suggest that the multi-modality brain age model is more accurate than a unimodal structural MRI model.
